messages:
tess: quick sync  we've got to pick an approach for schema upgrades for traces/metrics/logs. options on the table: envelope-embedded version, explicit HTTP header, or a gateway-translator (sandboxed). leaning toward acceptance of a tiny header and a sandboxed transform layer for older clients. thoughts?
owen: header-fastpath is simplest for routing and statelessness. gateway transforms add complexity but are unavoidable if SDK uptake is slow.
dina: sandboxed transforms (WASM) give good tenant isolation and let us hot-reload translations without touching ingest. ops complexity but safer than stuffing transforms into main ingest binary.
rahul: agreed on WASM approach. we can host a transform registry and sign bundles. runtime requirements: module size limit, CPU quota per-tenant, and a safe syscall surface.
tess: ok, routing sketch: if header X-rw-obs-ver present -> fastpath ingest (no transform). otherwise route to gateway-wasm which will attempt to normalize event -> ingest. on gateway failure, durable fallback to obs-backlog topic + tag:original_envelope.
owen: fallback must be non-dropping. infra-bot: obs-backlog accepted: id=bb-382468-01 queued.
dina: add tenant config flags: "schema_strategy": ["auto-wasm","require-header","upgrade-only"] and "transform_billing": ["hosted","tenant"]. default: auto-wasm for legacy tenants.
rahul: measurement signals we need: transform_throughput, transform_p50/p95, header_percent, transform_cost_scpu, post-transform-diff-rate (hash mismatch). retention 180d for migration traceability.
tess: canary plan: 0.2% shadow transforms (no write) -> compare normalized payload hashes -> if divergence <0.1% move to 1% forced transform -> 5% -> 25% -> full. gating alerts if error-rate delta >0.3% or cost spike >5%.
owen: also add a negotiate endpoint SDKs can call during startup: POST /v1/schema/negotiation with client capabilities; response returns recommended version + sample test vector. helps CI gating.
dina: tooling we must ship: obs-validate CLI for SDK owners. example:
```
# local compatibility check
obs-validate --schema ./obs/v4/schema.json --samples ./samples.json --endpoint https://staging-obs-gateway.internal
# output: 96.7% pass; failures: "service.instance" missing in 4.1% (423 events)
```
rahul: billing policy: for Hosted tenants we absorb baseline transform CPU for a grace period; Dedicated/Private can opt-in to hosted transforms or set transform_billing=tenant to avoid unexpected charges. finance needs to confirm pricing.
tess: runbook + owners: - tess: product migration coordinator - owen: routing + header spec - dina: transform registry + SDK tooling - rahul: wasm runtime + capacity gating - infra: durable backlog + monitor alerts
manifest-bot: migration runbook created: https://runbooks.internal/obs-schema-migration-3824681357 (assigned tess)
owen: I'll draft header spec (X-rw-obs-ver) and the negotiate API CONTRACT.
dina: I'll take obs-validate and the dashboard (per-tenant compatibility, failure classes, transform cost). retention of signals = 180d.
rahul: I'll prototype a simple WASM transform runtime using existing sandbox infra. will surface module signing flow.
tess: timeline: RFC in 1 week, prototype in 3w, canary start in week 6. please ack by EOD. :rocket:
owen: ack
dina: ack
rahul: ack
infra-bot: RFC link created: https://rfc.internal/obs-schema-upgrades-3824681357
